title: Does a Second-Class Primary Constraint Generate a Gauge Transformation? Electromagnetisms and Gravities, Massless and Massive
summary: In constrained Hamiltonian dynamics there are two views regarding how first-class constraints generate gauge transformations: individually or only in a certain combination, the Rosenfeld-Anderson-Bergmann-Castellani gauge generator. This gauge generator $G$ preserves Hamilton's equations and changes the canonical action at most by a boundary term; Hamiltonian's equations are the Euler-Lagrange equations for the canonical action.
